title: Etale comparison reflects universal coefficient normalization
statement: Let Z be a scheme, R and S finite commutative rings in Type(u+1), and q:R→S. Let C and Cprime be bounded derived fixed-ring module sheaves on Z_et and δ:C→Res_q(Cprime). Apply exact etale-to-proetale comparison to δ and follow by the canonical localIsomorphismComparisonCoefficients(q) at Cprime [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. If that specified arrow is initial in the structured-arrow category for proetale derived scalar restriction, then δ is initial in the structured-arrow category for etale derived scalar restriction. There is no adic tower, actual pulled coefficient presentation, marking, or further etale source in this assertion.

source.place: Tags 06YS (K-flat resolutions), 0G7E (pullback preserves K-flat complexes with flat terms), and 0D6D (composition of derived pullbacks). Also proetale.tex Tag 09B1 for exact conservative comparison, or the small etale site Tag 03ED for etale source restriction, respectively.

proof.text: Identify the displayed localIsomorphismComparisonCoefficients with the inverse of pbcDerivedComparisonRestrict from the existing witness-compatibility module. At the sheaf level comparison_restrict_mate identifies the mate of pbcComparisonRestrict inverse with the identity restriction square; the inverse mates equivalence therefore identifies it with normalizationPullbackMate. Passing through the exact-functor localization comparisons and their symmetry laws gives the equality of the specified derived natural isomorphisms, not merely an unspecified comparison.

Use the already proved pbcRestriction_isRightAdjoint to choose both derived scalar adjunctions, and pbcComparisonReductionMap_isIso for invertibility of the left mate m of the identified restriction square. For d:X to U(Y), let t:L(X) to Y be its scalar adjunct. The mate unit identity and naturality of the restriction comparison show that m_X followed by comparison(t) is the scalar adjunct of the specified compared arrow. Its induced structured-arrow morphism joins the initial scalar-adjunction unit to the assumed initial arrow, so it is invertible. Since m_X is invertible, comparison(t) is invertible. The sheaf comparison is faithful by the invertible underived comparison unit. Exactness gives H^n(comparison(t)) = comparison(H^n(t)); faithful exact comparison reflects each homology isomorphism, hence t is invertible in the unbounded derived category. The isomorphism t transports the initial scalar-adjunction unit to d. All generic categorical glue and homology reflection are proved privately in the item module. This argument needs neither a Tor bound nor boundedness of scalar extension, and applies to zero rings and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 0G7E, implemented by the existing proved pbcRestriction_isRightAdjoint and pbcComparisonReductionMap_isIso of WitnessCompatibility; Stacks proetale comparison unit, Tag 099T, as proved by isIso_comparisonAdjunction_unit. V6 supplies the exact comparison identification, categorical initiality argument, and unbounded homology reflection.

lean.statement:
theorem comparisonNormalization_reflects_universal (Z : Scheme.{u})
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Finite R] [Finite S]
    (q : R →+* S)
    {C : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))}
    {C' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))}
    (_hC : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj C))
    (_hC' : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj C'))
    (δ : C ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Z.smallEtaleTopology q).obj C')
    (h : Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal
      (StructuredArrow.mk
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Z).mapDerivedCategory.map δ ≫
          (localIsomorphismComparisonCoefficients q).hom.app C') :
        StructuredArrow _ (normalizationRestrict (ProEt.topology Z) q)))) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal
      (StructuredArrow.mk δ : StructuredArrow _
        (normalizationRestrict Z.smallEtaleTopology q)))
